posts.name: Yak Guardian
posts.cooked:
I was working on a custom font for a personal project and thought it would be cool to have the (H) icon available. Before long I had that and black & white versions of the Hero Icons (based on the AMAZING work of Jagarciao).  Assuming that the GtG guys are OK with it, I would be glad to share the link for the font here (and/or send it to Spiff if he wanted to host it on his AWESOME SotM Resources page).

 

Just for the record, this font is obviously for personal, non-commercial use only (assuming GtG says it's OK to share it at all). No infringement on GtG's intellectual property rights is intended nor should be inferred.

posts.name: Spiff
posts.cooked:
I found an online font generator where you download a template, put the stuff you want to be a font into the right spots on the template, then upload the template back to the site and it turns your stuff into an actual font.  Using that and a copy of the "H" like Christopher has, I was able to make a custom SotM font that includes the "H".  It also includes the "SV", "EV", etc. icons that I needed for my oversized cards.

I posted the font (or maybe a link to it?) in another topic on the forum where we discussed this very topic.  Maybe with a little digging, you could find it if you were interested.
